# Copilot instructions

Read `docs/HANDOFF.md` first.

- Provide public-health awareness only; do not diagnose, prescribe, or invent data.
- Restrict sources to verified Indian government and WHO domains.
- Run emergency detection deterministically before model calls.
- Show coming-soon/no-verified-info when coverage is absent.
- The owner runs nothing manually; perform commands, tests, and verification yourself.
- Do not claim completion without exact printed evidence.
- Use one branch per phase and small conventional commits.
- Keep secrets, `.env`, PDFs, vectorstores, databases, and caches out of Git.
